interface.signature: numBusesToDestination(routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of bus routes is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 10**5 for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route has between 1 and 100,000 stops.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= stop < 10**6 for route in routes for stop in route)
preconditions.description: Each bus stop ID is between 0 and 999,999.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if S not in {stop for route in routes for stop in route} or T not in {stop for route in routes for stop in route} else True
postconditions.description: Return -1 if either the starting stop S or the target stop T is not present in any bus route.
The number of buses taken is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if S == T else True
postconditions.description: If the starting stop S is the same as the target stop T, no buses are needed.
The returned value is the minimum number of buses needed to reach the target stop T from the starting stop S.
